description: This file contains rendering logic for violations and formulas in a specification checking system, including display implementations and conversion functions, as well as definitions for PrettyFunction.

classes.name: RenderedViolation
classes.description: A wrapper struct for formatting Violation instances as strings.

classes.name: RenderedFormula
classes.description: A wrapper struct for formatting Formula instances as strings.

classes.name: PrettyFunction
classes.description: A struct representing a formatted version of functions for display purposes.

methods.name: render_violation
methods.description: Converts a Violation into a human-readable string.

methods.name: fmt
methods.description: Implementation of std::fmt::Display for RenderedViolation and RenderedFormula for custom string formatting.

methods.name: time_to_ms
methods.description: Converts a Time object to milliseconds since UNIX_EPOCH.

methods.name: with_pretty_functions
methods.description: Converts formulas and violations to use PrettyFunction for display.
